mn35:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn35:2.1: tena kho pana samayena saccako niganthaputto vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati bhassappavādiko paṇḍitavādo sādhusammato bahujanassa.
mn35:2.2: so vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
mn35:2.3: nāhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇācariyaṃ apica arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya yassa na kacchehi sedā muñceyyuṃ
mn35:2.4: thūṇañcepāhaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ sāpi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya
mn35:3.1: atha kho āyasmā assaji pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn35:3.2: addasā kho saccako niganthaputto vesāliyaṃ jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ dūratova gacchantaṃ
mn35:3.3: disvāna yenāyasmā assaji tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā assajinā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn35:3.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho saccako niganthaputto āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca
mn35:4.1: kathaṃ pana bho assaji samaṇo gotamo sāvake vineti kathaṃbhāgā ca pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatīti.
mn35:4.2: evaṃ kho aggivessana bhagavā sāvake vineti evaṃbhāgā ca pana bhagavato sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattati
mn35:4.3: rūpaṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ vedanā aniccā saññā aniccā saṅkhārā aniccā viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ
mn35:4.4: rūpaṃ bhikkhave anattā vedanā anattā saññā anattā saṅkhārā anattā viññāṇaṃ anattā
mn35:4.5: sabbe saṅkhārā anattā sabbe dhammā anattāti
mn35:4.6: evaṃ kho aggivessana bhagavā sāvake vineti evaṃbhāgā ca pana bhagavato sāvakesu anusāsanī bahulā pavattatīti.

mn35:22.1: seyyathāpi aggivessana puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kudhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya
mn35:22.2: so tattha passeyya mahantaṃ kadalikkhandhaṃ ujuṃ navaṃ akukkuṭajātaṃ
mn35:22.3: tamenaṃ mūle chindeyya mūle chetvā agge chindeyya agge chetvā pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujeyya
mn35:22.4: so tattha pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujanto phegguṃpi nādhigaccheyya kuto sāraṃ
mn35:22.5: evameva kho tvaṃ aggivessana mayā sakasmiṃ vāde samanuyuñjiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno ritto tuccho aparaddho
mn35:22.6: bhāsitā kho pana te esā aggivessana vesāliyaṃ parisati vācā
mn35:22.7: nāhantaṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇācariyaṃ apica arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya yassa na kacchehi sedā muñceyyuṃ
mn35:22.8: thūṇañcepāhaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ sāpi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya
mn35:22.10: tuyhaṃ kho pana aggivessana appekaccāni sedaphusitāni nalāṭamuttāni uttarāsaṅgaṃ vinibbhinditvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitāni
mn35:22.11: mayhaṃ kho pana aggivessana natthi etarahi kāyasmiṃ sedoti.
mn35:22.12: iti bhagavā tasmiṃ parisati suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ kāyaṃ vivari.
mn35:22.13: evaṃ vutte saccako niganthaputto tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdi.
mn35:23.1: atha kho dummukho licchaviputto saccakaṃ niganthaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhāṇaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn35:23.4: seyyathāpi bhante gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī
mn35:23.6: atha kho bhante sambahulā kumārakā vā kumārikā vā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā yena sā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkameyyuṃ upasaṅkamitvā taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā taṃ kakkaṭakaṃ udakā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpeyyuṃ
mn35:23.7: yaññadeva hi so bhante kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃtadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalena vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ
mn35:23.8: evañhi so bhante kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ puna otarituṃ seyyathāpi pubbe
mn35:23.9: evameva kho bhante yāni saccakassa niganthaputtassa visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici tāni bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni
mn35:23.10: abhabbo cadāni bhante saccako niganthaputto puna bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ yadidaṃ vādādhippāyoti.
mn35:24.1: evaṃ vutte saccako niganthaputto dummukhaṃ licchaviputtaṃ etadavoca
mn35:24.2: āgamehi tvaṃ dummukha āgamehi tvaṃ dummukha mukharosi tvaṃ dummukha na mayaṃ tayā saddhiṃ mantema idha mayaṃ bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ mantema
mn35:24.3: tiṭṭhatesā bho gotama amhākañceva aññesañca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācāvilāpaṃ
mn35:24.5: kittāvatā ca nu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane viharatīti.
mn35:24.6: idha aggivessana mama sāvako yaṅkiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
mn35:24.10: viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
mn35:24.11: ettāvatā kho aggivessana mama sāvako sāsanakaro hoti ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane viharatīti.
mn35:25.1: kittāvatā pana bho gotama bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
mn35:25.2: idha aggivessana bhikkhu yaṅkiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anupādāvimutto hoti.
mn35:25.6: viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anupādāvimutto hoti.
mn35:25.7: ettāvatā kho aggivessana bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto.
mn35:26.1: evaṃ vimutto kho aggivessana bhikkhu tīhānuttariyehi samannāgato hoti
mn35:26.3: evaṃ vimuttacitto aggivessana bhikkhu tathāgatañceva sakkaroti garukaroti māneti pūjeti
mn35:26.4: buddho so bhagavā bodhāya dhammaṃ deseti danto so bhagavā damathāya dhammaṃ deseti santo so bhagavā samathāya dhammaṃ deseti tiṇṇo so bhagavā taraṇāya dhammaṃ deseti parinibbuto so bhagavā parinibbānāya dhammaṃ desetīti.
mn35:27.1: evaṃ vutte saccako niganthaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn35:27.2: mayameva bho gotama dhaṃsī mayaṃ pagabbhā ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha
mn35:27.3: siyā hi bho gotama hatthiṃ pabhinnaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo
mn35:27.4: siyā hi bho gotama pajjalitaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo
mn35:27.5: siyā hi bho gotama āsīvisaṃ ghoravisaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo na tveva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo
mn35:27.6: mayameva bho gotama dhaṃsī mayaṃ pagabbhā ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha
mn35:27.7: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn35:28.1: atha kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā te licchavī āmantesi
mn35:28.2: suṇantu me bhonto licchavī samaṇo gotamo nimantito svātanāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena
mn35:28.3: yena me abhihareyyātha yamassa paṭirūpaṃ maññeyyāthāti.
mn35:29.1: atha kho te licchavī tassā rattiyā accayena saccakassa niganthaputtassa pañcamattāni thālipākasatāni bhattābhihāraṃ abhihariṃsu.
mn35:29.2: atha kho saccako niganthaputto sake ārāme paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
mn35:30.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena saccakassa niganthaputtassa ārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn35:30.2: atha kho saccako niganthaputto buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn35:30.3: atha kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcāsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn35:30.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saccako niganthaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn35:30.5: yamidaṃ bho gotama dāne puññañca puññamahī ca taṃ dāyakānaṃ sukhāyeva hotūti.
mn35:30.6: yaṃ kho aggivessana tādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma avītarāgaṃ avītadosaṃ avītamohaṃ taṃ dāyakānaṃ bhavissati
mn35:30.7: yaṃ kho aggivessana mādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ taṃ tuyhaṃ bhavissatīti.
